description: She wears an opaque dark blue floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted paneled bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Fine gold geometric borders follow the neckline, bodice seams, cuffs and hem. A blue and gold woven sash with a circular decorative buckle and fringed hanging tail wraps the waist. Round gold clasps accent the shoulder straps. A pale beige woven wrap edged in blue and gold rests across the forearms and hangs at both sides with fringe. The ivory underdress and brown closed boots are visible below the front skirt opening. Exact textile fiber is uncertain.
